svg.title: Free AI models, right inside Pi
svg.desc: Public model metadata is validated and published as a GitHub Pages snapshot for Pi's local catalog. Inference requests go to the active provider rather than the catalog host. Reviewed Free Pools are opt-in and support model selection, per-model thinking settings and scheduling.
